sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Messiah University and Taylor University are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership codes reported by College Scorecard. Messiah University, located in Mechanicsburg, has an undergraduate enrollment of 2,259 students, while Taylor University in Upland enrolls 2,025 undergraduates. These differences highlight variations in size, location, and cost between Messiah vs Taylor.
